purpose: Single registry of the platform capability cores tracked by CAPABILITY-CORES-NOT-WIRED. A core is 'wired' only when a named non-test production consumer imports it. The guard ratchets on this file: a wired core may never silently lose its consumer, and a pending core may never be described as wired without one.
not_this: This registry is NOT about optional feature activation (ml_pest_detection, ml_yield_prediction, ml_field_boundary, aquacrop_salinity). Those are governed separately and share only the word 'capability'. Conflating them would mark this gap closed while these cores remain orphaned.

cores.note: Consumed by list_equipment via ?summary=true. Folded into the existing route, so no domain route was spent. Fail-closed: absent maintenance policy yields not_evaluated, never a fabricated due.

Consumed by internal_field_state via ?canonical=true; no domain route spent (INT-004A). HONESTY BOUND, recorded because it is not a defect: the contract requires weather+water+soil and this service produces only water (api/canonical_water_state.py). Nothing in the tree emits canonical_soil_state./soil-profile. or wx10/canonical-weather-state/, so the state returns operational_eligible=false with required_weather_unavailable and required_soil_unavailable named. Wired on owner instruction to declare the gaps explicitly rather than leave the core orphaned; the alternative -- fabricating a schema-valid product -- would make an unusable state look valid. Eligibility becomes true only when a soil producer and a weather product producer exist.

Consumed by query_yield_map_records via ?summary=true; no domain route spent (INT-004A). The overlap check the previous note asked for came back clean: calibration_factor has exactly one owner in the tree, this core. api/yield_map_ingestion.py parses and persists; it never aggregates or calibrates. Fail-closed on scope: a truncated page, or a scope spanning more than one ingestion or season, yields not_evaluated rather than a plausible mean.

Consumed by scenario_economics on POST /api/v1/scenario/economics. One domain route spent deliberately: the feasibility endpoint takes a different input model (area_ha/price_per_t), so folding it there would have been forced. Fail-closed: an incomplete scenario is not_evaluated with each missing input named, and is never ranked against a complete one.
